run.title: steme audit — Scope Boundary Rule Family

commit.subject: feat(steme): move the rulepack schema to v2 with multi-source and concept clauses
commit.body:
Bump the rulepack contract to schemaVersion 2: fromScope accepts one scope or
a non-empty array, forbiddenScopes becomes optional alongside a new
forbiddenConcepts list, and exceptSourceConcepts declares source-concept
exceptions. The strict parser pins schemaVersion === 2 and validates every new
field against the canonical scope and concept key sets, accumulating named
config errors that keep exiting 2. The shipped boundaries rulepack and test
fixtures move to v2 unchanged in content.

phases.title: Rulepack schema v2: multi-source and concept clauses

commit.subject: feat(steme): add the hardcoded concept map with glob matching and integrity preflight
commit.body:
Add a dependency-free segment glob matcher (* one segment, ** any depth) and a
hardcoded concept map binding core.composition and core.capabilities to their
canonical globs. The audit preflight validates containment (a concept's files
live inside its owning scope) and refuses rules referencing undeclared
concepts with a named config error and exit 2, so concept clauses can never
half-run.

phases.title: Concept map, glob matcher, and integrity preflight

commit.subject: feat(steme): evaluate multi-source rules, source-concept exceptions, and concept targets
commit.body:
Extend rule evaluation to the v2 semantics: fromScope arrays, source-concept
exceptions checked before targets, and forbiddenConcepts matching edges that
resolve into a concept's files — including same-scope edges such as core
domain reaching core/composition. Violations carry the violated concept and
diagnostics name it in the concept field and repair texts. Unit tests pin the
exception-first ordering and the single-violation rule for scope+concept
double matches.

phases.title: Evaluate concept clauses: exceptions and concept targets

commit.subject: feat(steme): ship the full scope-boundary rule family with composition-root exceptions
commit.body:
Replace the single walking-skeleton rule with the decided 12-rule boundary
family: per-source inter-scope prohibitions for core, web, webRpc, contracts,
adapters, utils, cli, webhooks and jobs, plus three composition-root rules —
only core/composition may import adapters, core must not reach the composition
root except from capability files, and entry surfaces must never reach it.
Two shared skills (scope-boundaries, composition-root) replace the subsumed
core-must-not-import-web skill. The E2E harness proves every rule
seed → flag → fix → pass, both exceptions silent, and the pristine sandbox
green under all 12 rules.

phases.title: Ship the boundary rule family, skills, and the full seed matrix
